enrichGroupInfo.description: Add the group's name, description, member count, creation date, privacy, rules and admins to posts. Works for public groups; private groups return their public profile only.
enrichGroupInfo.title: Include group profile

fetchAllComments.description: Fetch the full comment thread for each post, not just the inline top comments. This is slower and can add many rows of comment data.
fetchAllComments.title: Fetch full comment threads

includeCommentReplies.description: Attach replies to each fetched comment. Only used when full comment threads are enabled.
includeCommentReplies.title: Include comment replies

includeTopComments.description: Include each post's inline top comments, with comment text, author, reactions and reply count.
includeTopComments.title: Include top comments

maxCommentsPerPost.description: Comment budget per post, including replies. Only used when full comment threads are enabled.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Max comments per post

maxItems.description: Maximum number of posts to return per group. Post links always return one post.
maxItems.title: Max posts per group

monitoringMode.description: Return only posts not seen in a previous run for the same group or post link, so scheduled runs return just what is new.
monitoringMode.title: Monitor mode (only new posts)

onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Keep posts created after this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative value such as '7 days' or '24 hours'. Applied while collecting posts.
onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than

onlyPostsOlderThan.description: Keep posts created before this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative value such as '30 days'.
onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Only posts older than

searchKeyword.description: Keep only posts whose text contains this keyword (case-insensitive). Applied while collecting posts.
searchKeyword.title: Keyword filter

sortBy.description: How to order each group's feed.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Facebook group URLs, bare group slugs or numeric IDs, or links to individual group posts.
startUrls.title: Group or post URLs

title: Facebook Group Feed & Engagement Extractor Input
